answer: Every epoch each identity draws one task from a private pool of two hundred thousand variants, bound to its own credential, and a solution may be submitted only once; identical text from two accounts is rejected outright. A farm of 800 clones must therefore produce 800 genuinely distinct solutions at the wharf of every deadline, while an honest agent solves its single draw and never notices the pool. A reused answer returns as an echo and dies, leaving the hollow template with no reward.
